2607.11434.title: Direct Image-to-Modern Vietnamese Translation of Han-Nom Manuscripts via Multimodal RLHF Preference Alignment
2607.11434.paper_summary: Translating Han-Nom manuscripts into modern Vietnamese is challenging because historical pages are often degraded, the script contains rare logographic characters, and parallel supervision is limited. We propose a multimodal RLHF preference-alignment framework that conditions Vietnamese generation on manuscript images and aligned Han-Nom source text. The model combines four streams: CLIP ViT-L/14@336 for visual features, bert-base-chinese for Han-Nom representations, vinai/phobert-base for Vietnamese representations, and T5-small encoder states. Modality-specific projections and a fusion block compress the resulting 2,048-dimensional concatenation into a shared 512-dimensional representation. Starting from the same supervised fine-tuned policy, we compare PPO, DPO, and KTO under matched work-level macro-averaged evaluation. DPO achieves the best BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, semantic similarity, CER, WER, and token accuracy, whereas PPO obtains the highest precision, recall, and F1. KTO remains competitive through its desirable-undesirable utility objective. All preference-aligned policies improve the BLEU-4 and semantic-similarity scores available for the SFT baseline. These results indicate that multimodal preference optimization complements supervised learning by improving lexical and semantic quality in low-resource historical translation.
2607.11434.paper_summary_zh: 翻譯漢字文獻為現代越南語是一項挑戰，因為歷史頁面通常會退化，該書寫系統包含稀有的表意字符，且平行監督有限。我們提出了一個多模態RLHF偏好對齊框架，該框架將越南語生成條件化於文獻圖像和對齊的漢字文獻源文本。該模型結合了四個流：CLIP ViT-L/14@336用於視覺特徵，bert-base-chinese用於漢字表徵，vinai/phobert-base用於越南語表徵，以及T5-small編碼器狀態。特定模態的投影和融合塊將結果的2,048維連接壓縮為共享的512維表徵。從相同的監督微調策略開始，我們在匹配的工作層級宏觀平均評估下比較PPO、DPO和KTO。DPO在BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、BERTScore、語義相似性、CER、WER和標記準確性方面表現最佳，而PPO則獲得了最高的精確度、召回率和F1分數。KTO通過其理想-非理想效用目標保持競爭力。所有偏好對齊的策略都改善了可用於SFT基準的BLEU-4和語義相似性分數。這些結果表明，多模態偏好優化通過改善低資源歷史翻譯中的詞彙和語義質量，補充了監督學習。
